gloss: to speak frankly, to open up

definitions.gloss: to speak frankly, to open up, to be candid
definitions.explanation: To reveal one's true thoughts and feelings honestly without hiding anything.

examples.japanese: {腹|はら}を{割|わ}って⟦{話|はな}そう→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。

examples.english: He and I are on candid terms with each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{腹|はら}を{割|わ}って⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧、⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解|と}けた→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧。
examples.english: I had a frank discussion with my boss, and the misunderstanding was resolved.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Literally 'to split one's belly,' referring to exposing what is inside oneself (one's true feelings). In Japanese culture, the belly (⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧) is traditionally seen as the seat of emotions and true intentions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {腹|はら}を{割|わ}って⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to talk frankly)
- {腹|はら}を{割|わ}った⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧ (candid relationship)
- {腹|はら}を{割|わ}った⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧ (close, honest relationship)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{本音|ほんね}→本音：06620_honne⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to speak one's true feelings)
- {胸襟|きょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to open one's heart, more formal)
